import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    h = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    left, right = 0, n - 1
    left_max = right_max = 0
    answer = 0
    # settle the side whose known maximum is lower: its water level is already fixed
    while left <= right:
        if left_max <= right_max:
            if h[left] > left_max:
                left_max = h[left]
            answer += left_max - h[left]
            left += 1
        else:
            if h[right] > right_max:
                right_max = h[right]
            answer += right_max - h[right]
            right -= 1
    print(answer)


main()
